notes.title: Here are some basic game controls:
notes.content:
WASD to move
Mouse to look around
Right/left click for blocks/materials
Space for jump
T to fly (Once you collect some chicken and crow feathers)

Double press keys 1-9 for item selection
0 to select hand tools/weapons
Left/right click when fishing and hunting
Right click to place items on tools, wood/straw on fires to keep them burning, place harvested food in pot to make soups
Left click to plant and harvest crops

Gold can be used to make any minerals you can't find

R will change the shape of blocks, really enhances the players creative ability

Esc pulls up the options menu in game. If needed you can adjust the draw setting from full, medium or small to help fps. You can also turn the Orc's off.
